messages:
maria: thinking about adding a small API shim that surfaces per-invocation crediting for prefetch/cache hits so the cost dashboard doesn't double-count. idea: attach credit_id to invocation meta and expose /v1/invocations/:id/credits. Thoughts?

ashwin: +1. main risk is double attribution when cache is shared across tenants. we need a stable lineage id and a clear source field. sampling will make the UI tricky though. :thinking_face:

maria: agree. propose we only attribute credits to the tenant that triggered the prefetch (originator) and store origin_credit_id on the prefetch event. will that break sticky-routing chargebacks?

oliver: sticky routing will need to see origin vs served. emit both origin_tenant and served_tenant in telemetry so the chargeback job can decide. avoid assigning prefetch savings to the served_tenant by default.

jk: can we add an `X-Credit-Id` header and a `credit_reason` enum? quick example:```http
POST /v1/generate HTTP/1.1
Authorization: Bearer $KEY
X-Credit-Id: pref-12345
X-Credit-Reason: PREFETCH
```

sophie: for dashboard UX: show an "apportioned savings" column and an expand control to inspect lineage (origin->served->model). default rollup should be per-model + per-tenant aggregated for the last 7d.

pm-zoe: product ask: this must be canary-safe. initial API should be opt-in behind a feature flag and we need a migration plan for historic invoices. we also need guardrails for tiny credits so finance doesn't get noisy reports.

deploybot: deploybot: canary deployed to us-west-2 (commit 9f3b7c) :rocket:

ashwin: telemetry event sketch: `INVOCATION` { id, model, tenant_id_served, tenant_id_origin?, tokens_in, tokens_out, credit_id?, credit_type?, credit_value_tokens, sample_rate } — store raw events and reconciled aggregates. keep sample_rate in the event.

maria: reconciliation idea: nightly job that rolls up credits vs billed tokens. if mismatch > 0.5% trigger alert + create a ticket. can we add a reconciliation dashboard widget?

jk: security: watch out for client-side spoofed credit headers. require server-signed credit tokens (HMAC) issued by prefetch service. header becomes `X-Credit-Token: <signed>` and we validate TTL + signature.

oliver: yep use KMS to sign/verifiy. token payload can include origin_tenant, credit_id, model_hash, issued_at, ttl.

sophie: UX note: hide per-invocation credits by default in the console. only show aggregated rows + a "drilldown by invocation" opt-in. filter threshold: show credits >= 50 tokens or >= $0.01 by default.

pm-zoe: timeline check — can we get an alpha next week? need wireframes and a short billing/finance runbook for the pilot.

maria: i'll draft the API proto today and post a PR. action items: @ashwin telemetry schema, @jk header spec + hmac approach, @sophie dashboard mocks, @pm-zoe rollout & finance sync. :thumbsup:

ashwin: ack.

jk: ack.

sophie: sending mocks by EOD.

pm-zoe: i'll coordinate finance and draft the rollout checklist.

maria: thanks all — i'll follow up with the proto link when ready.
